clips.title: The story
paras: Arcanist Doan is a master human mage residing within the Athenaeum of the Scarlet Monastery's Library wing. He serves the Scarlet Crusade as one of its most lethal arcane specialists and guardian of key crusade archives.

While the fanatical ranks of the Scarlet Crusade lean heavily on martial fury and holy fervor, Doan remained convinced that raw arcane power was essential to purging the Scourge from Lordaeron. Stationed deep inside the Athenaeum of the Monastery's library, he was entrusted as both a lorekeeper and an operational gatekeeper, safeguarding the Scarlet Key that secures crusade sanctuaries across the northern kingdoms.
